flashcard_questions.q: What is a persistent vegetative state?
flashcard_questions.a: A condition where a patient breathes independently but has no awareness and no hope of recovery.

flashcard_questions.q: How does active euthanasia end a patient’s life?
flashcard_questions.a: By deliberate action, such as giving a lethal injection.

flashcard_questions.q: How does passive euthanasia end a patient’s life?
flashcard_questions.a: By withdrawing or withholding treatment and allowing death to follow.
The dying patient has requested death themselves.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Act makes abortion legal in England, Scotland and Wales?
What must happen before an abortion can legally go ahead in Britain?
flashcard_questions.a: Two doctors must agree that at least one legal condition applies.

flashcard_questions.q: Who was Tony Bland in the euthanasia debate?
flashcard_questions.a: A Hillsborough victim left in a persistent vegetative state with irreversible brain damage.

flashcard_questions.q: When was life-prolonging treatment withdrawn from Tony Bland?
What did Parliament decide about a right-to-die law in September 2015?
flashcard_questions.a: MPs rejected it by 330 votes to 118.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible verse do Catholics apply directly to abortion?
Which Bible verse says God knew a person before they were formed in the womb?
What do the Greek words eu and thanatos together mean?
What did Dr Gunning warn would follow from accepting euthanasia?
flashcard_questions.a: Hundreds of other problems would soon be seen as solvable by killing.

flashcard_questions.q: What name is given to the moment Muslims believe the soul enters the foetus?
Why is euthanasia haram in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: Life is a gift from Allah, and only Allah decides when it ends.

notes: 15 cards: 5 term→definition (PVS, active/passive/voluntary euthanasia, ensoulment), 3 legal/case facts (Abortion Act, two doctors, Tony Bland), 2 date cards (1993, 2015 vote), 2 belief→source (Exodus 20:13, Jeremiah 1:5), 1 etymology, 2 argument→view (Dr Gunning, Islamic view). Kept this deck distinct from the sister abortion/euthanasia lesson by using its case studies and legal detail.
